496	// ApplyHealth records an offline observation once the shared revision gate has
497	// passed.
498	//
499	// The gate is shared with Select (see checkServiceRevision): a revision
500	// mismatch is a conflict carrying the request and current revisions even when
501	// the service or the targeted instance is missing, and a matching request for
502	// an unknown service is not_found. Only after it does health apply its own
503	// rules:
504	//   - a missing instance is not_found;
505	//   - a sequence below the accepted one is stale and reports the current sequence;
506	//   - the same sequence with identical normalized status and reason succeeds
507	//     without changing state;
508	//   - the same sequence with different content is a conflict;
509	//   - a newer sequence writes the status and reason.
510	func (r *Registry) ApplyHealth(upd HealthUpdate) HealthOutcome {
511		st, fail := r.checkServiceRevision(upd.Service, upd.Revision)
512		if fail != nil {
513			return fail.asHealth(upd.Service)
514		}
515		cur, ok := st.instances[upd.InstanceID]
516		if !ok {
517			return HealthOutcome{
518				Service:    upd.Service,
519				InstanceID: upd.InstanceID,
520				OK:         false,
521				Kind:       OutcomeNotFound,
522				Reason:     fmt.Sprintf("instance %q does not exist in service %q", upd.InstanceID, upd.Service),
523				Revision:   st.revision,
524			}
525		}
526		if upd.Sequence < cur.sequence {
527			return HealthOutcome{
528				Service:    upd.Service,
529				InstanceID: upd.InstanceID,
530				OK:         false,
531				Kind:       OutcomeStale,
532				Reason:     fmt.Sprintf("sequence %d is older than the current sequence %d", upd.Sequence, cur.sequence),
533				Revision:   st.revision,
534				Sequence:   cur.sequence,
535			}
536		}
537		if upd.Sequence == cur.sequence {
538			want := HealthUnhealthy
539			if upd.Healthy {
540				want = HealthHealthy
541			}
542			if cur.health == want && cur.reason == upd.Reason {
543				return HealthOutcome{
544					Service:    upd.Service,
545					InstanceID: upd.InstanceID,
546					OK:         true,
547					Changed:    false,
548					Revision:   st.revision,
549					Sequence:   cur.sequence,
550				}
551			}
552			return HealthOutcome{
553				Service:    upd.Service,
554				InstanceID: upd.InstanceID,
555				OK:         false,
556				Kind:       OutcomeConflict,
557				Reason:     fmt.Sprintf("sequence %d already used with different health content", upd.Sequence),
558				Revision:   st.revision,
559				Sequence:   cur.sequence,
560			}
561		}
562		// Newer sequence: record the observation. Health updates never bump the
563		// registration revision.
564		if upd.Healthy {
565			cur.health = HealthHealthy
566			cur.reason = ""
567		} else {
568			cur.health = HealthUnhealthy
569			cur.reason = upd.Reason
570		}
571		cur.sequence = upd.Sequence
572		return HealthOutcome{
573			Service:    upd.Service,
574			InstanceID: upd.InstanceID,
575			OK:         true,
576			Changed:    true,
577			Revision:   st.revision,
578			Sequence:   cur.sequence,
579		}
580	}

582	// validateSessionRequest is the content validation shared by select and
583	// release_session. It trims the service name and range-checks the raw
584	// expectedRevision before it is narrowed to int, then normalizes the session
585	// key:
586	//
587	//   - a nil key means the field was absent: an ordinary rotating selection is
588	//     legal for select (keyRequired == false), while release_session rejects
589	//     it with missingKeyReason because its key is mandatory;
590	//   - a present key is trimmed; keys equal after trimming name one session
591	//     within a service, and a blank-after-trim key is invalid with a reason
592	//     naming the sessionKey problem.
593	//
594	// The order mirrors every other request kind — service name, then the
595	// revision range, then the remaining content field — so content validity is
596	// fully established before any revision comparison against the registry.
597	// Null and non-string key tokens are a JSON concern handled by callers before
598	// this helper runs and never arrive here as a *string.
599	func validateSessionRequest(service string, revision int64, sessionKey *string, keyRequired bool, missingKeyReason string) (name string, rev int, key string, err error) {
600		name, err = validateServiceName(service)
601		if err != nil {
602			return "", 0, "", err
603		}
604		if err = validateExpectedRevision(revision); err != nil {
605			return "", 0, "", err
606		}
607		if sessionKey == nil {
608			if keyRequired {
609				return "", 0, "", errInvalid(missingKeyReason)
610			}
611			return name, int(revision), "", nil
612		}
613		key = strings.TrimSpace(*sessionKey)
614		if key == "" {
615			return "", 0, "", errInvalid("sessionKey must not be empty")
616		}
617		return name, int(revision), key, nil
618	}

657	// Select chooses one healthy instance for the service once the shared revision
658	// gate has passed.
659	//
660	// The gate is shared with ApplyHealth (see checkServiceRevision): a mismatch is
661	// a conflict carrying the request and current revisions (an unknown service is
662	// at revision 0), and a matching request for an unknown service is not_found.
663	// Only after it does select apply its own rule: an existing service with no
664	// healthy instance is no_healthy and no address is fabricated. A registered
665	// service with an empty instance list still compares by its real revision; the
666	// gate hands it through so the answer is no_healthy, not not_found.
667	//
668	// Healthy instances rotate per service by ascending instance id: the first
669	// success takes the smallest id and each later success continues just after
670	// the previously chosen id, wrapping to the smallest id past the end. With a
671	// single healthy instance it may be chosen repeatedly. Registrations and
672	// health changes alter the candidate set immediately but never reset the
673	// rotation; failed selections leave the cursor where it was.
674	//
675	// A request carrying a session key is sticky: while the key's bound instance
676	// is still registered and healthy at selection time, it is returned with its
677	// current address and latest accepted health sequence, and the rotation
678	// cursor does not move. A binding that points at a removed, unknown or
679	// unhealthy instance is ignored — an instance whose id survived an address
680	// change is unknown until a fresh observation at the new address, so its old
681	// health record never carries over — and the request falls back to the normal
682	// rotation, which on success advances the cursor and replaces the binding.
683	// The first selection for a key behaves exactly like an ordinary rotation
684	// success and additionally records the binding. Failed selections (including
685	// no_healthy) create no binding, rewrite none and move no cursor.
686	func (r *Registry) Select(sel Selection) SelectOutcome {
687		st, fail := r.checkServiceRevision(sel.Service, sel.Revision)
688		if fail != nil {
689			return fail.asSelect(sel.Service)
690		}
691	
692		// A bound session reuses its instance while it is registered and healthy;
693		// the reuse reflects the instance's current address and sequence and does
694		// not advance the rotation.
695		if sel.SessionKey != "" {
696			if id, bound := st.sessions[sel.SessionKey]; bound {
697				if cur, ok := st.instances[id]; ok && cur.health == HealthHealthy {
698					return SelectOutcome{
699						Service:    sel.Service,
700						OK:         true,
701						Revision:   st.revision,
702						InstanceID: id,
703						Address:    cur.address,
704						Sequence:   cur.sequence,
705					}
706				}
707			}
708		}
709	
710		healthy := make([]string, 0, len(st.instances))
711		for id, cur := range st.instances {
712			if cur.health == HealthHealthy {
713				healthy = append(healthy, id)
714			}
715		}
716		sort.Strings(healthy)
717		if len(healthy) == 0 {
718			return SelectOutcome{
719				Service:  sel.Service,
720				OK:       false,
721				Kind:     OutcomeNoHealthy,
722				Reason:   fmt.Sprintf("service %q has no healthy instance available", sel.Service),
723				Revision: st.revision,
724			}
725		}
726	
727		chosen := healthy[0]
728		if st.cursorSet {
729			chosen = healthy[0]
730			for _, id := range healthy {
731				if id > st.cursor {
732					chosen = id
733					break
734				}
735			}
736		}
737		cur := st.instances[chosen]
738		st.cursor = chosen
739		st.cursorSet = true
740		if sel.SessionKey != "" {
741			if st.sessions == nil {
742				st.sessions = make(map[string]string)
743			}
744			st.sessions[sel.SessionKey] = chosen
745		}
746		return SelectOutcome{
747			Service:    sel.Service,
748			OK:         true,
749			Revision:   st.revision,
750			InstanceID: chosen,
751			Address:    cur.address,
752			Sequence:   cur.sequence,
753		}
754	}

756	// ReleaseSession drops one session binding once the shared revision gate has
757	// passed.
758	//
759	// The gate is the same one health and select use (see
760	// checkServiceRevision): a revision mismatch is a conflict carrying the
761	// request and current revisions (an unknown service is at revision 0), and a
762	// matching request for an unknown service is not_found — including when
763	// expectedRevision is 0. Only after it does release do its own work.
764	//
765	// Releasing deletes at most the named key's binding in the named service. It
766	// never consults the bound instance's state: whether that instance was
767	// removed, never observed healthy, is currently unknown/unhealthy, or the
768	// service's instance list is empty cannot keep the binding in place, since
769	// the binding is only a remembered id. Releasing a key that has no binding
770	// still succeeds with Changed left false. No target is chosen, so the result
771	// carries no instance id, address or health sequence.
772	//
773	// The release moves and resets neither the rotation cursor nor any other
774	// session's binding (including another session bound to the same instance and
775	// the same key in another service), and it never alters the instance list,
776	// the registration revision or a health record. The next selection with the
777	// released key follows the first-binding rule: it rotates from just after the
778	// last actually rotated position and records a fresh binding only on success.
779	func (r *Registry) ReleaseSession(rel SessionRelease) ReleaseOutcome {
780		st, fail := r.checkServiceRevision(rel.Service, rel.Revision)
781		if fail != nil {
782			return fail.asRelease(rel.Service)
783		}
784		_, bound := st.sessions[rel.SessionKey]
785		if bound {
786			delete(st.sessions, rel.SessionKey)
787		}
788		return ReleaseOutcome{
789			Service:  rel.Service,
790			OK:       true,
791			Changed:  bound,
792			Revision: st.revision,
793		}
794	}

839	// parseAddress validates a host:port address: domains, IPv4 and bracketed IPv6.
840	// No network I/O is performed.
841	func parseAddress(raw string) (string, error) {
842		addr := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
843		if addr == "" {
844			return "", fmt.Errorf("instance address must not be empty")
845		}
846		for _, r := range addr {
847			if unicode.IsSpace(r) || unicode.IsControl(r) {
848				return "", fmt.Errorf("instance address %q must not contain whitespace or control characters", addr)
849			}
850		}
851		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
852		if err != nil {
853			return "", fmt.Errorf("instance address %q is not a host:port address: %v", addr, err)
854		}
855		if host == "" {
856			return "", fmt.Errorf("instance address %q has an empty host", addr)
857		}
858		if !allDigits(port) {
859			return "", fmt.Errorf("instance address %q port %q must be a decimal integer", addr, port)
860		}
861		n, err := strconv.Atoi(port)
862		if err != nil {
863			return "", fmt.Errorf("instance address %q port %q must be a decimal integer", addr, port)
864		}
865		if n < 1 || n > 65535 {
866			return "", fmt.Errorf("instance address %q port %d is out of range (1-65535)", addr, n)
867		}
868		if strings.HasPrefix(addr, "[") {
869			ip := net.ParseIP(host)
870			if ip == nil || !strings.Contains(host, ":") {
871				return "", fmt.Errorf("instance address %q bracketed host is not a valid IPv6 address", addr)
872			}
873		} else if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil {
874			if ip.To4() == nil {
875				return "", fmt.Errorf("instance address %q IPv6 addresses must be bracketed", addr)
876			}
877		} else if !isDomainName(host) {
878			return "", fmt.Errorf("instance address %q host %q is not a valid domain, IPv4 or bracketed IPv6", addr, host)
879		}
880		return addr, nil
881	}

883	func allDigits(s string) bool {
884		if s == "" {
885			return false
